messages:
marta: Okay team, who keeps moving the blue felt whiteboard eraser? It was on the lower shelf and now it's on top of the microwave with a post-it: "Left for quiet hours."

owen: that was me. It hums at night and I couldn't focus. I swear I heard it whisper "pair with marker C". :sweat_smile:

diego: evidence please. did you record the whisper? :mag_right:

own: no recording, just the vibes. I propose we name it 'The Quiet Eraser' and give it a tiny sleeping bag.

nym: agh, please no more appliance accommodations. We already have a kettle oracle. :laughing:

ops-bot: Note: office quiet hours are 22:00-07:00. Please respect shared spaces. :crescent_moon:

sam: We should make a rota: Eraser Custody — overnight sits on top of the microwave to absorb late-night stress. Volunteers?

zoe: I nominate @owen since he initiates the relocations. Also I can make a tiny felt sleeping bag.

marta: Also asking: who left a tiny doodle of a wizard on the eraser last week? Its now officially enchanted if so.

oven: guilty. He now accepts spell-checking duties and occasionally erases my typos.

nym: I will petition for an enamel pin: an eraser with Zzzs. If approved, sales fund the tiny sleeping bag.

diego: Clause: if eraser relocates to microwave, the owner must leave a note explaining reasons in 3 words or less.

marta: Fine: "Too loud, needed calm." Agreed?

owen: Agreed. Will leave tiny sticker: "Eraser on night watch" when needed.

ops-bot: Kitchen audit reminder Thu 11:30. Personal items on appliances risk disposal. Please label.

zoe: Ritual established. The Quiet Eraser now has a bedtime policy. Please respect its naps. :sleeping:
